Campbells Auctioneers are delighted to present this attractive parcel of land to the open market, situated in the peaceful townland of Craghyboyle, Dungloe, Co. Donegal.

Extending to approximately 1.6 acres, the property is offered for sale subject to planning permission and enjoys a tranquil rural setting while remaining conveniently located just a short drive from the town of Dungloe.

The property benefits from generous road frontage.

Dungloe offers an excellent range of amenities including Shops, Schools, Cafés, Restaurants, Traditional Pubs, Supermarkets, and Healthcare Services.

The surrounding area is renowned for its breathtaking scenery, unspoilt beaches, rugged coastline, and abundance of outdoor recreational opportunities.


For further information, please contact Campbells Auctioneers.
